What is ForgePix?

ForgePix turns many photos into one better image — fully automatically, and it explains what it does.

🔬 Macro: several close-ups with shifting focus → one fully sharp image.
🌌 Astro: many frames of the night sky → noise-free.
🌗 Hybrid: Moon/Sun mosaic or Focus+Astro.
📷 Long exposure: from a burst without an ND filter (silky water, light trails …).

It's simple: pick a module → choose a folder (or drop it on the window) → ⚡ Automatic. In Beginner mode one click is enough; Pro mode opens all controls.

The AI is optional — everything runs without a server too. It only advises and never secretly changes pixels.

More in the guide (docs/GUIDE) and via the “?” next to each setting. Shortcuts: F1.

Tonlook fürs Ergebnis. Exposure Fusion i: Tone look for the result. Exposure fusion is flat by nature — Natural adds subtle contrast/pop (default), Vivid more, Dramatic strong local contrast (clouds/structure), Neutral leaves it flat. Faithful — tones only, no invented content.
Translation = nur Verschiebung (nachgefü: Translation = shift only (tracking mount, fast). Translation + field rotation = also aligns rotated fields (Alt-Az mount without rotator, long sessions) — via star features.
Untersucht die Fokusreihe: verwackelte F: Examines the focus series: shaky photos, redundant frames, focus coverage and the optimal frame count.
Verfahren, das aus dem Sensor-Mosaik das: Method that computes the colour image from the sensor mosaic. "auto/ahd" default, "dht" high quality, "dcb" low false colour, "vng" soft.
Verrechnet Belichtungsreihen (Lichter +: Merges exposure brackets (highlights + shadows recovered, exposure fusion). This is NOT focus stacking. Handheld series are aligned automatically.
Verschmilzt die Serie zusätzlich in Grup: Also merges the series in groups of neighbouring shots and stores the partial results as brush sources (0 = off). Useful where an out-of-focus foreground shows through: paint over it with the group that only contains the front shots. The final result stays unchanged — measurements show grouping brings no benefit to the automatic merge; the value is in the painting.
Verschmilzt hierarchisch je zwei Fotos (: Merges hierarchically two photos at a time (1+2, 3+4, …) and then the results further — instead of all at once. Because only two very similar images are combined at each step, the result is often cleaner with many frames. Slightly slower.
Vom Stativ: „nicht ausrichten“. Bei leic: On a tripod: "don't align". For slight shake "shift" (translates), handheld "features" (aligns fully).

Wenn dein Ordner mehrere Foto-Serien in: If your folder contains several photo series in subfolders (e.g. several flowers), each series is stacked separately. The automatic also detects this by itself.
Wie Farben/Weiß interpretiert werden. „c: How colours/white are interpreted. "camera" = the camera's setting (recommended), "auto" = computer estimates, "daylight" = daylight.
Wie die scharfen Bereiche verschmolzen w: How the in-focus areas are merged. “pyramid” = Laplacian pyramid (default): very sharp, ideal for fine/soft structures like flowers and fur. “depthmap” = depth-map selection: picks the sharpest photo per pixel — strong on hard depth edges (insects, coins, circuit boards), but often softer than the pyramid on soft subjects.

How the sharp regions are merged. "pyramid" = Laplacian pyramid (default): very sharp, ideal for fine/soft structures like flowers and fur. "depthmap" = depth-map selection: picks the sharpest photo per pixel — strong on hard depth edges (insects, coins, circuit boards). "halofix" = dual-output halo retouch (sharpness without halos). "wavelet" = à-trous detail fusion.
Wie fein Farbabstufungen gespeichert wer: How finely colour gradations are stored. 16 = highest quality for editing (recommended), 8 = smaller, less headroom.
Wie groß die Fotos für die Schärfe-Messu: How large the photos are downscaled for the sharpness measurement. Higher = more accurate but slower. 1600 is a good value.
Wie markante Punkte zum Ausrichten gefun: How distinctive points for alignment are found. ORB = fast (default), SIFT = more accurate on low-texture subjects but slower.
Wie stark das Übersprechen zwischen den: How strongly the crosstalk between channels is removed. −1 = the starting value of the chosen filter (recommended). Higher separates more sharply but can subtract real signal.
Wie streng verwackelte Einzelfotos ausso: How strictly shaky single frames are dropped. Higher = stricter. Only photos clearly blurrier than their neighbours (real shake) are dropped — not the naturally soft ends of the focus series.
Wie viele Belichtungen eine Reihe bilden: How many exposures make up one bracket (e.g. 3 for −1/0/+1 EV). 0 = detect automatically. Multiple brackets in a folder are each merged into their own HDR.
Wie viele Sekunden Ruhe (kein neues Foto: How many seconds of quiet (no new photo) before stacking automatically — so the copy has surely finished.
Wie ähnlich zwei Fotos sein müssen, um a: How similar two photos must be to count as duplicates. Smaller = stricter.
Wähle das Einzelfoto, dessen scharfe Ste: Choose the single frame whose sharp area you want to bring to the painted position.

2× erzeugt ein doppelt so breites und ho: 2× produces an image twice as wide and high. Enable Drizzle reconstruction below to integrate the original measurements. Otherwise the result is interpolated.
Verteilt die Originalmessungen flächenan: Distributes original measurements onto the new grid by overlapping area. Bayer FITS retain individual color sensor samples. Well-distributed dithers are needed; missing pixels remain visible in coverage maps. CFA Drizzle currently does not support additional cosmetic or banding correction. More memory is required.
1× behält die Originalgröße bei und ist: 1× keeps the original size and is the starting point for Bayer Drizzle. 2× requires more dither positions and memory. Enable Drizzle reconstruction below to integrate original measurements. Otherwise enlargement is interpolated.
Nicht belegte Farbkanäle bleiben markier: Missing color samples remain marked. For larger gaps, use more dither positions or normal stacking.
Ergebnisdatei und Begleitdateien werden: The result and companion files are copied unchanged with verified checksums. FITS pixels, headers and coverage masks are preserved. No JPG or 16-bit conversion is applied.
